name: Bravo 9/200 + VWAP
pine:
//@version=5
indicator("Bravo 9/200 + VWAP", overlay=true)

fastLen = input.int(9,   "Fast MA length", minval=1)
slowLen = input.int(200, "Slow MA length", minval=1)
useEma  = input.bool(false, "Use EMA instead of SMA")
useSess = input.bool(true,  "Reset VWAP each session")

maF = useEma ? ta.ema(close, fastLen) : ta.sma(close, fastLen)
maS = useEma ? ta.ema(close, slowLen) : ta.sma(close, slowLen)

// ---- session-anchored VWAP ----
newSess = useSess ? ta.change(time("D")) != 0 : barstate.isfirst
tp = (high + low + close) / 3.0
var float pv = 0.0
var float vv = 0.0
if newSess
    pv := 0.0
    vv := 0.0
pv += tp * volume
vv += volume
vwapLine = vv > 0 ? pv / vv : na

plot(vwapLine, "VWAP",    color=color.orange,  linewidth=2)
plot(maF,      "MA fast", color=color.aqua,    linewidth=2)
plot(maS,      "MA slow", color=color.fuchsia, linewidth=2)

// ---- armed-cross signals ----
var int pending = 0
if ta.crossover(maF, maS)
    pending := 1
else if ta.crossunder(maF, maS)
    pending := -1

buySig  = pending ==  1 and maF > maS and close > maF and close > maS
sellSig = pending == -1 and maF < maS and close < maF and close < maS
if buySig or sellSig
    pending := 0

plotshape(buySig,  "Buy",  style=shape.labelup,   location=location.belowbar, color=color.new(color.teal, 0), text="BUY",  textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny)
plotshape(sellSig, "Sell", style=shape.labeldown, location=location.abovebar, color=color.new(color.red, 0),  text="SELL", textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny)
alertcondition(buySig,  "Bravo buy",  "9 crossed above 200 and price is above both")
alertcondition(sellSig, "Bravo sell", "9 crossed below 200 and price is below both")
note: Plots the session VWAP with a 9-period and a 200-period moving average, and marks a BUY under the bar when the 9 has crossed above the 200 and price closes above both averages, a SELL above the bar on the mirror condition.
warning: This replaces the old 'Bravo 9' definition: the previous version drew a DeMark-style 9-bar exhaustion count, and per your message it is now the 9/200 moving-average pair, so any earlier '9' marks are gone. Three choices you should know about: (1) 'price is above both' is tested against the two moving averages only — VWAP is drawn as a reference line and is not part of the signal; say the word and I'll add it as a third condition. (2) The cross arms the signal and it fires on the first bar price is clear of both averages, which may be the cross bar itself or several bars later; it then stays silent until the next cross, so you get one BUY per cross, not a repeating stream. (3) I dropped the VWAP standard-deviation bands (and the band_mult param) to keep five plots off the price pane — ask and they come back. Averages are simple by default; set use_ema=1 for EMAs. The 200 MA needs 200 bars to form, so the first 200 bars are null and no signal can print there — on a short intraday window you may see nothing at all. Also, with session_reset=1 on daily bars every bar is its own session, so VWAP collapses to that bar's typical price; use session_reset=0 for daily charts.
prompt: change the current indicator if you can please, I want you to keep the vpwap but the brtavo 9 is the 9 period moving average and the 200 moving average so plot those as well as the vwap. and its a buy signal plotten on the chart when the 9 moves above and price is above both and a sell when the opposite happens.
